$description: Input, Textarea, Select (platform/components/Input), library wave 6, lane B: the tokens of the appearances (filled, underline) and of the autogrowing text area. The outline appearance and the states are the shared input tokens.

input-filled-background.$description: Filled field: the neutral fill behind the value (the search field's fill).

input-filled-end-radius.$description: Filled field: square corners at the line under it.

input-underline-background.$description: Underline field: no fill; the surface shows through.

input-underline-radius.$description: Underline field: no corners, only the line under it.

textarea-auto-grow-max-height.$description: Autogrowing text area: the tallest it grows (ten lines, its padding and border); past it, it scrolls inside.
